public.title: Group By
public.description: Group rows by their field key, whose value is a string or integer. Return a key-to-array object; rows retain input order within groups. Object key order is irrelevant; all rows contain key. Supported inputs contain at most 100 array entries per sequence and at most 20 operations or requests per sequence, at most 60 total object properties and array elements in any single JSON value, nesting depth at most 8, strings at most 100 ASCII characters unless specified otherwise, and integers from -100 through 100 unless a tighter or explicit alternate bound is stated. The entire argument JSON encoding is at most 1000 bytes. Nested sequences collectively have at most 100 entries; output snapshots therefore remain bounded. Inputs always satisfy the described shape and bounds.
hints: Append each row to its group rather than prepending it.
Check the public examples against the documented empty-input and boundary rules.

explanation: Allocate a dictionary group on first encounter and append rows in traversal order. O(n) expected time and O(n) output space. This JSON adapter verifies observable results; it does not establish built-in-method restrictions, garbage collection, browser behavior or real timer/microtask scheduling.
